title: Systematic CMB Constraints on Early-Universe Modifications: Parameter Degeneracies and Null Results
abstract: Implements two Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) mechanisms in CLASS—(i) a smooth modification to the photon–baryon coupling \dot{\kappa}(z) and (ii) a Gaussian-windowed, radiation-like background energy fraction \epsilon at recombination—and tests them against the Planck 2018 CMB TT spectrum with amplitude marginalization. A 2D parameter analysis shows both mechanisms yield null results once degeneracies with h are accounted for, turning an apparent 1D “detection” into a parameter-degeneracy artifact.
